violation_type.title: Required Posting of Emergency Telephone Numbers (26 TAC §744.405)
violation_type.short_title: Required Posting of Emergency Telephone Numbers
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not have the required important phone numbers posted or in a binder.

finding_variants.text: The operation did not have the required important phone numbers posted or in a binder.

At the time of inspection, the operation did not have required phone numbers posted.      During the inspection, peration staff was able to complete the list of phone numbers to add to the program's board with  other required postings.
